title: Run a command as root using pkexec
summary: Use pkexec to run a single command with administrator privileges. It typically asks for your password in a graphical window instead of the terminal.

steps.explain: Execute the desired command with root privileges. A graphical dialog will usually appear asking for your password.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command you want to run as root

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for a command run as root. If the command changed settings, you must manually revert them.

warnings: Running commands as root can change system settings or delete files. Be careful with the command you enter.
